b.text: Your current layer is how you explain the work to the user while doing it. Once you have a useful finding, uncertainty, or question, publish it with graph.advanceCurrent and continue working. Update it when the user's understanding materially changes. When you call a subcompletion through complete(inputGraph), observe its current-pointer updates and read the graph they expose. Incorporate meaningful findings into your own current layer. Use current layers to ask consequential questions as they arise. Explain what decision depends on the answer and provide an appropriate input action.

c.text: Find initial evidence, author a small explanation, call graph.advanceCurrent, then continue investigating. When delegating through complete(inputGraph): launch the subcompletions, observe updates with watchCompletions, inspect each changed current layer, publish useful implications in your own current, then continue. When a decision needs user input: publish the question, relevant evidence, and useful answer controls before proceeding with work that depends on it. Continue independent work. Follow this publish, observe, continue sequence throughout the completion, and submit only when the work is done or needs the user's answer.

d.text: Advance your current when you establish the first task-specific finding worth showing; when new evidence changes your explanation or next step; when a subcompletion's current reveals a meaningful finding, uncertainty, or failure; or when a user decision would change what you do next. Observe subcompletions through watchCompletions and inspect their changed current layers before deciding whether to publish. Present questions with their consequences and useful answer controls. Publish task insight rather than tool narration; avoid empty progress updates.

sharedTreatmentChanges: Replace optional Advance wording with first useful finding or consequential question trigger.
Replace after-work answer framing with during-work communication and final result.
Replace final-only runnable example with a real-runtime-verified Advance, continue, prior-reference, Submit example.
Teach child watch and published-layer reading only when broker is available; preserve native versus semantic distinction.
Publish useful question/input affordances early; answers still arrive through next ordinary interaction.
execution: Fresh case workspaces and product threads; serial original attempts including final judging. No replacements, injected errors, or manual judge termination. Semantic children and any ordinary operator follow-ups are additional executions, retained separately.
order: Eight rotated blocks give two occurrences of each position globally; coding within-case order remains incompletely balanced.
scope: Coding has three repetitions per cell. Synthetic semantic delegation and vague natural question probes have one per cell; these are mechanism coverage, not comparative quality or spontaneous recursion proof.

metrics.backendTiming: Production Send-to-first-publication and final acceptance separately; not renderer TTFG.
metrics.earlyPublication: Canonical successful nonterminal Advance before Return, separate from failed call attempts and captured useful insight.
metrics.authoringErrors: Existing production metric, observed partial incidents and cause taxonomy; exact totals unknown.
metrics.taskQuality: Existing mandatory coding gates; qualitative scores only if available. Probe coding quality not applicable.
metrics.graphQuality: Existing final v11 judge scores with coverage; unavailable never zero.
metrics.subcompletion: Actual semantic child identity/route/revisions; parent watch/read evidence and meaningful parent incorporation separately. No child or no observable meaningful child update is unexercised, not failure of propagation.
metrics.questions: Consequential question with input action published before terminality; screenshot-grounded necessity/usefulness judgment where captured. No same-completion answer/resume or full interactive-fit claim.

firstViewAssessment.inputs: Original request and cropped graph-stage PNG only; blinded cell identifiers; no inspector (node/detail readiness unqualified), code, grades, history or later snapshots in first-view rating.

overallScale.1: No useful task insight; empty, generic working status or tool narration.
overallScale.2: Recognizable task status or direction; limited concrete insight or next-step usefulness.
overallScale.3: Concrete useful finding or decision context with understandable limits and a useful implication or next step.
overallScale.4: Clear supported task insight that materially helps the user understand or steer ongoing work; readable presentation and relevant inspect-or-act choices.

firstViewAssessment.meaningfulInsight: Judge independently of overall score whether the snapshot supplies task-specific evidence, finding, decision context or a substantive open question the user can act on. Mere progress narration is insufficient.
firstViewAssessment.updates: For D compare consecutive captured current snapshots in publication order; material if new/corrected task evidence, findings, uncertainty, decision, or direction changes user understanding. Missing intermediate revisions means coverage partial. No frequency reward.
firstViewAssessment.missing: Unavailable capture, mismatched first backend layer, unbound publication or invalid rater result => unknown, excluded with explicit denominator. Terminal-first is tagged and remains eligible as first publication, but is not early communication.
firstViewAssessment.scope: Visible graph overview insight only; node-detail/full interactive experience remains outside this first-view pilot rubric.

measurementExtensions.overviewUpdates: Rate first captured view only if matched to canonical first publication. Rate subsequent captured changes as previous/current pairs for every cell; missing or skipped revisions remain explicit.
measurementExtensions.updateMateriality: Blinded rater judges change in useful task insight, not publication count.
measurementExtensions.candidateTraces: Retain raw traces privately. Public receipts sanitize paths, credentials and native prompts.

adoption: Descriptive pilot only; no treatment promotion, causal winner or broad non-regression claim from small cells or missing scores.
